verdict.rationale: The chip's software stack supports Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) deployment, C++/Python APIs, and a multi-language server interface, and docs show LLM inference examples run on Linux (llm_linux.html) without GUI dependency — all consistent with headless/automatable use. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, no mention of containerized or scripted automation workflows, and no evidence of headless-mode testing in community reports. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, headless-mode confirmation, containerized deployment examples, and independent verification of automation use.
